snippet.title: Gales of Nayeli - Accessibility Trailer - Access-Ability Summer Showcase
snippet.description: Face an impending darkness threatening the world of Iuven alongside Nayeli and an interesting cast of warriors. Control varied battlefields in Grid-Based Strategy RPG format to bring an end to a conflict that is certain to echo across generations.
